messages:
jamal_sales: Heads-up - OrchidCare wants a 2-week POC. Their checklist: SAML SSO, SCIM (delta), group-based RBAC, delegated admins, domain lock, EU residency for PHI, and pricing differences for hosted vs dedicated.

alex_k: good. expected user count and provisioning cadence? do they require <30s provisioning?

jamal_sales: ~900 users now, plan ~9k in 12 months. Bulk imports + deltas, they'd prefer near-realtime for hires (<30s). Delegated admin is a must.

maria_product: product note: Hosted supports SAML + SCIM v2 and group mapping; default SCIM throttle 200 req/min. Dedicated/Private can run in eu regions, support customer-managed KMS, higher rate limits, and delegated-admin tooling. Domain proofing (DNS/TXT) supported in Hosted.

ben_eng: SCIM specifics: we accept Okta delta tokens and bulk endpoints. Hosted: 200 req/min; Dedicated configurable to 1k+/min. For <30s recommend Okta outbound webhooks or Dedicated with raised rate limits. Example patch payload: PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id} with groups array.

olivia_sec: security: can provide SOC2 Type II, TLS 1.2+, AES-256 at rest. Customer KMS/HSM and EU-only tenancy require Dedicated/Private. I can assemble questionnaire answers + redwood-sec-package-v2.pdf in 48h; contract/legal items ~72h.

jamal_sales: they want a sample SAML metadata and attribute list to share.

alex_k: SAML snippet to send: <saml2:EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com"> <md:SPSSODescriptor> <md:AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.redwood.example.com/sso/callback"/> </md:SPSSODescriptor> </saml2:EntityDescriptor>. Attributes: email, givenName, familyName, name, groups (array).

maria_product: POC scope suggestion: include SSO, SCIM group sync, and domain verification in Hosted. Exclude delegated admin and customer KMS (move to Dedicated for full support). I'll draft pricing ballpark and migration path.

jamal_sales: action items: Jamal to request Okta SCIM adapter config + peak rates; Olivia to prep sec artifacts in 48h; Ben to write one-pager on latency/options; Maria to draft pricing. Tagging @olivia_sec @ben_eng.

sec_bot: Reminder: attach redwood-sec-package-v2.pdf when responding to security questionnaires - https://internal.redwood.com/sec/redwood-sec-package-v2.pdf

jamal_sales: sending SAML/SCIM guidance and sec package link to customer, will update when they share logs.
